title: RestoreProof signature v1
description: restoreproof.signature.v1: signature.json, the file beside result.json that holds the result's signature (W4.3, docs/decisions.md 2026-10-05, point 2). Written as canonical-json-v1. Five keys, all always there, never a sixth. bundle_sha256 is the SHA-256 of result.json's bytes; signature is the Ed25519 signature over that digest's 32 raw bytes, in standard Base64 with padding (64 bytes, 88 characters); key_id is the SHA-256 of the signing key's public half as SubjectPublicKeyInfo DER. The file is not itself signed: a verifier takes the public key from its caller, never from here. The schema uses only keywords JSON Schema draft 7 and 2020-12 read alike.
